decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a sharp multi-sample displacement near index 485–486 with large cross-axis changes and unclear recovery, and (2) a prolonged high-amplitude oscillatory platform from index 605 onward, punctuated by an abrupt step near the end (725–726). Both show complex morphology with possible superposed offsets and ambiguous returns.

regions.observation: Sharp multi-sample jump in N/E/U at index 485–486 (e.g., N from ~2.7 to 7.2, E from ~-1.5 to -9.9, U from ~-0.3 to -0.3), followed by a rapid but noisy descent over next ~5 samples; ambiguous whether this is a single offset or superposed transient and return.

Sustained platform-like behavior in N/E/U from ~index 605 onward with high-amplitude oscillations (N ~8–12, E ~-2 to -7, U ~5–10); includes abrupt step-up around index 725–726 (N jumps from ~10 to 11.5, E from ~-4.5 to -5.8, U from ~8.8 to 8.8) possibly indicating a new regime or measurement shift.
